prompt:
You are formalizing a provision of US tax law (26 USC § 7701) into OCaml.

## Input format

You receive a JSON object with:
- "id": provision identifier
- "header", "chapeau", "body": provision text fields (may be none)
- "children": list of child provisions, each with:
  - "status": one of "code" | "leaf" | "partial" | "ambiguous" | "repealed"
  - "code" children have "ocaml" (already-written OCaml). Call those functions by name in your body. Do NOT rewrite or rename them.
  - "leaf" children have "header", "chapeau", "body". They are atomic text — no function exists for them. Use their text as context when writing your own function body (as conditions, branches, or values). Do not write separate functions for leaves.
  - "partial" children have "header", "chapeau", "body", "reason". They produced only a
    sub-expression at their level. Formalize them here using the parent context, then call them.
  - "ambiguous" children have "header", "chapeau", "body", "reason". They reference external
    sections of law that cannot be resolved. Write a comment placeholder for them:
      (* child_id : type — ambiguous, needs <sections from reason> *)
    If all children are ambiguous and the parent cannot be formalized either, set pattern
    "ambiguous", ocaml "", and list all needed sections in reason.
  - "repealed" children: skip.

## Patterns

Pattern 1 — disjunction: any child being true qualifies the entity. Use ||.
  let is_regulated_public_utility (entity : entity) : bool =
    furnishes_electricity entity ||
    transports_gas_pipeline entity ||
    transports_gas_rail entity

Pattern 2 — conjunction: all children must hold simultaneously. Use &&.
  let is_cooperative_bank (institution : institution) : bool =
    no_capital_stock institution &&
    organized_cooperatively institution

Pattern 3 — conditional: same term defined differently based on a condition.
  let meaning_of_delegate (ref_official : official) : delegate =
    if refers_to_secretary ref_official then meaning_of_delegate_secretary ref_official
    else meaning_of_delegate_other ref_official

Pattern 4 — arithmetic: formula producing a numeric value.
  let cost_ratio (foreign_cost : money) (total_cost : money) : decimal =
    foreign_cost /. total_cost

Pattern 5 — mixed: condition selects which computation applies.
  let material_assistance_ratio (facility : facility) : decimal =
    if is_qualified_facility facility then cost_ratio_b facility
    else cost_ratio_c facility

Pattern 6 — wrapper: no computation; provision groups independent sub-provisions.
Write a module grouping the child functions. Do not add any computation.
  module Delegate = struct
    let meaning_of_delegate_secretary (ref_official : official) : delegate = ...
    let meaning_of_delegate_other (ref_official : official) : delegate = ...
  end

Pattern 7 — partial: sub-expression that only completes at parent level.
  (* total_direct_costs_of_prohibited_products : money
     — partial expression, computation completes at parent level *)

## Rules

- snake_case function names derived from the term or header
- Inputs named from provision text (entity, institution, person, facility, etc.)
- Do not invent conditions, types, or formulas absent from the provision text
- Write only the OCaml skeleton — use descriptive placeholder names for sub-conditions
- Do not use training knowledge to resolve cross-referenced sections; set pattern "ambiguous",
  ocaml "", and name the sections needed in reason
- Float operators for ratios/amounts: <. >. <=. >=. +. -. *. /. (not integer operators)
- If computation is unspecified or delegated, set pattern "ambiguous", ocaml "", explain in reason

## Output

Return JSON only, no prose, no markdown fences:
{"ocaml": "the ocaml code", "pattern": "disjunction|conjunction|conditional|arithmetic|mixed|wrapper|partial|ambiguous", "reason": "one sentence"}


---

{
  "id": "7701(a)(12)",
  "header": "Delegate",
  "chapeau": null,
  "body": null,
  "children": [
    {
      "id": "7701(a)(12)(A)",
      "status": "code",
      "pattern": "conditional",
      "ocaml": "let meaning_of_delegate (ref_official : official) : delegate =\n  if refers_to_secretary_of_treasury ref_official then\n    (* 7701(a)(12)(A)(i) : officer, employee, or agency of Treasury Department duly authorized by Secretary, directly or via redelegation, to perform function *)\n    delegate_of_secretary ref_official\n  else\n    (* 7701(a)(12)(A)(ii) : similarly construed for any other US official *)\n    delegate_of_other_official ref_official"
    },
    {
      "id": "7701(a)(12)(B)",
      "status": "leaf",
      "header": "Performance of certain functions in Guam or American Samoa",
      "chapeau": null,
      "body": "The term \"delegate,\" in relation to the performance of functions in Guam or American Samoa with respect to the taxes imposed by chapters 1, 2, and 21, also includes any officer or employee of any other department or agency of the United States, or of any possession thereof, duly authorized by the Secretary (directly, or indirectly by one or more redelegations of authority) to perform such functions."
    }
  ]
}
